description: Rough monthly money at stake from AI-agent refund mismatches, from the brand's own numbers. Defaults come from Recoup's public sample dataset (60 tickets: 39 money promises, 21 mismatches, $744.25 at stake), not from customer data. Always present the result as an estimate.

ai_tickets_per_month.description: Tickets closed by the AI agent per month

average_amount.description: Average amount at stake per mismatch in USD. Default 35.44 from the sample.

mismatch_share.description: Share of money promises that do not match Shopify or Stripe (0 to 1). Default 0.538 from the sample.

money_promise_share.description: Share of those tickets that promise a refund, credit or replacement (0 to 1). Default 0.65 from the sample.

name: estimate_refund_exposure
title: Estimate refund exposure
